# Critical-Path Decisions (Phase 5; generated by build_phase5_review.py)

44 decisions reviewed: P0 22 · P1 13 · P2 5 · P3 4. Classes: VERIFIED_FACT 4, TECHNICAL_RECOMMENDATION 19, SCIENTIFIC_CHOICE 17, UNRESOLVED 4. **All PENDING_HUMAN_APPROVAL.**

Priority rules: **P0** blocks valid experimental execution (data/class/split/model/threshold definitions, missing implementation, gates). **P1** must be settled before the configuration freeze but does not change split assignment or class definitions. **P2** can be completed alongside implementation. **P3** documentation / non-blocking.

Key Phase-5 re-assessment: under LOTO outer and LOTO_within_train inner splits every family nests inside one topology, so the family-map decisions (Y-D03, Y-D04) do **not** change any split; they affect only the uncertainty unit (F-D13) and development-mode query-family exclusion, hence P1.
